name: KromiumProxy
description: Defines the proxy strategy for the Kromium browser engine and client sessions. Supports Operating System Default, Direct bypass, WPAD Auto-Discovery, PAC script URLs, HTTP/HTTPS secure tunnels, SOCKS5 (with remote DNS resolution), and Multi-Protocol routing.
whenToUse: Configure in KromiumBrowserConfig, KromiumClientConfig, or dynamically at runtime via client.updateProxy(proxy) or browser.proxyManager.updateProxy(proxy).

methods.name: toCommandLineArgs
methods.description: Generates Chromium command-line switches (e.g. --proxy-server, --proxy-bypass-list) for process initialization.

methods.name: toPreferenceMap
methods.description: Generates the CEF preference dictionary required for dynamic runtime proxy reconfiguration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates proxy parameters and throws KromiumException.InvalidConfig if blank or out of range.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.signature: open fun getCredentials(host: String?, port: Int? = null): Pair<String, String>?
methods.description: Returns authentication credentials (username to password) configured for this proxy if the requested target matches.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Factory method returning the System singleton proxy.

methods.name: direct
methods.description: Factory method returning the Direct singleton proxy.

methods.name: autoDetect
methods.description: Factory method returning the AutoDetect WPAD singleton proxy.

methods.name: pac
methods.description: Factory method creating a PAC script proxy.

methods.name: http

methods.description: Factory method creating an authenticated or unauthenticated HTTP forward proxy.

methods.description: Factory method creating a MultiProtocol proxy router.

exceptions.name: KromiumException.InvalidConfig
exceptions.whenThrown: When proxy host is blank, port is not in 1..65535, PAC script URL is blank, or multi-protocol config has no rules.
exceptions.recovery: Provide a non-empty hostname or IP, set port within 1..65535, and ensure valid endpoint URLs.

variants.name: KromiumProxy.System
variants.description: Uses operating system default proxy configuration.

variants.name: KromiumProxy.Direct
variants.description: Bypasses all proxies and connects directly to destination hosts.

variants.name: KromiumProxy.AutoDetect
variants.description: Automatically discovers proxy settings using Web Proxy Auto-Discovery (WPAD) via DHCP/DNS queries.

variants.name: KromiumProxy.Pac
variants.declaration: data class Pac(val pacUrl: String) : KromiumProxy()
variants.description: Connects using a Proxy Auto-Configuration (PAC) script URL (e.g. http://pac.corp.internal/wpad.dat).

variants.name: KromiumProxy.Http
variants.declaration: data class Http @JvmOverloads constructor(val host: String, val port: Int, val username: String? = null, val password: String? = null, val isSecure: Boolean = false, val bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()) : KromiumProxy()
variants.description: Connects via an HTTP or HTTPS forward proxy with optional credentials and bypass list.

variants.name: KromiumProxy.Socks5
variants.declaration: data class Socks5 @JvmOverloads constructor(val host: String, val port: Int, val username: String? = null, val password: String? = null, val remoteDns: Boolean = true, val bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()) : KromiumProxy()
variants.description: Connects via a SOCKS5 (or SOCKS4) proxy with remote DNS resolution to prevent DNS leaks.

variants.name: KromiumProxy.MultiProtocol
variants.declaration: data class MultiProtocol @JvmOverloads constructor(val http: String? = null, val https: String? = null, val ftp: String? = null, val socks: String? = null, val bypassList: List<String> = emptyList()) : KromiumProxy()
variants.description: Connects using separate, dedicated proxies for different network protocols (HTTP vs HTTPS vs SOCKS).
